    s3://northfield-glue-scripts/jobs/
- aws glue update-job --job-name northfield-orders-etl ...
- aws stepfunctions update-state-machine \
    --state-machine-arn ...:northfield-pipeline-orchestrator \
    --definition file://state-machines/*.asl.json
